caseName: Gargano v. Supreme Judicial Court of Massachussetts
caseNameFull: Gargano v. Supreme Judicial Court of Massachussetts

opinions.text: Ralph Thomas Mabry, Jr., of Silver Spring, Md., is suspended from the practice of law in this Court, and a rule will issue, returnable within 40 days, requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
